title: The unchanging hardships of the road
summary: The basic tortures of road life, too little rest, long drives and bad meals, are the same across eras.

blocks.x: Sure. Oh, the complexity of the business for you. Just being a bandleader and all the things that are required, the contrast from the 1930's to now. The nature of just society and business as part of society, has created a lot of demands.
Yeah, but I think the basic -- for instance, the basic tortures of the road are still there. You don't get enough rest, you drive too far, and you don't get a decent meal.
